sentences.text: Act vs In Re : Musim Bewa & Anr on 4 April, 2025

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
April 04, 2025 49 Ardr (Op) Crm(Db) 680 of 2025 In Re : An Application for bail under Section
483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with Kharagpur Town Police
Station Case No. 421 of 2023 dated 03/09/2023 under Sections 498A/304B/302/323/506/34 of
the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

And
 In Re : Musim Bewa & anr.
 ... Petitioner
Sr. Adv. Jayanta Narayan Chatterjee, Adv. Jayashree Patra, Adv. Ritushree Banerjee, ... for the
petitioners.

Adv. Debabrata Acharyya, Adv. Sk. Samsul Afefin, Adv. Sital Samanta, ...for the defacto
complainant.
Adv. Md. Adil Badr, Adv. Soumya Basu Roy Chowdhury, ... for the State.
The 1st petitioner is in custody for 223 days and the 2nd petitioner for about 375 days.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the 1st petitioner is a septuagenarian lady and is suffering from various ailments.

A report be called for from the Superintendent of the concerned Correctional Home with regard to the health of the 1st petitioner and also whether she is suffering from any ailment and if so, being treated for the same.

The State shall produce all the relevant documents pertaining to her treatment,
if any, at the Correctional Home.
With regard to the 2nd petitioner, his prayer for bail was turned down by this Court on merits on 7th March, 2024.
The application shall be considered upon submission of report by the Superintendent of the concerned Correctional Home.
Let the matter appear under the same heading on 21st April, 2025.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
